entities.summary: Elena Olegovna Bovina is a former professional tennis player from Russia. She reached a career-high singles ranking of world No. 14 in April 2005. Her best performance at a Grand Slam tournament came when she got to the quarterfinals of the 2002 US Open, defeating Clarisa Fernández, Jelena Dokic, Stéphanie Foretz, and Francesca Schiavone, before losing to Lindsay Davenport. Elena Bovina was a athletes & competitors from Moscow (b. 1983-03-10, Moscow). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
